svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Make two. Cut 40 mm slices of 40 x 40 x 4 mm angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One 8.5 mm hole in the middle of each leg, 20 mm from the corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the upright leg flat on the inner face of the upright, its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top level with the upright's top, M8 bolt through the upright;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the flat leg under the holder arm, M8 bolt up through both.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It sits 4 mm above the top of the axle plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the flat leg is level with the upright's top end.
